title.zh: 将基里诺省 Cabarroguis 市镇基里诺省医疗中心提升为三级综合医院并为其拨款的法案
title.en: An Act Upgrading the Quirino Province Medical Center in the Municipality of Cabarroguis, Province of Quirino, Into a Level Iii General Hospital, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Upgrading the Quirino Province Medical Center in the Municipality of Cabarroguis, Province of Quirino, Into a Level Iii General Hospital, and Appropriating Funds Therefor

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 6 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2025/ra_12292_2025.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en:
One (1) additional branch of the Regional Trial Court in the Tenth Judicial Region is hereby created and stationed in the Municipality of Maramag, Province of Bukidnon.
The Supreme Court shall assign the branch number for the newly created branch of the Regional Trial Court.

The Chief Justice of the Supreme Court, in coordination with the Secretary of the Department of Justice, shall immediately include in the Court's program the operationalization of the additional branch of the Regional Trial Court in the Municipalities of Maramag, Province of Bukidnon. The Supreme Court shall issue the necessary rules and regulations for the effective implementation of this Act and, if warranted, the realignment of seats of existing branches and their territorial jurisdiction.

The funds necessary for the implementation of this Act, including appropriations for personnel services such as salaries, benefits and emoluments for judges and court personnel, court operations under maintenance and other operating expenses (MOOE), and provisions for Halls of Justice or courtrooms to accommodate judges and court staff, as well as funds necessary for the implementation of automatically-created prosecutor positions pursuant to Section 13 of Republic Act No. 10071 or the "Prosecution Service Act of 2010" and appointment of public attorneys pursuant to Section 7 of Republic Act No. 9406 or the "Act Reorganizing and Strengthening the Public Attorney's Office (PAO), resulting from the creation of these courts, including appropriations for personnel services such as salaries, benefits, and emoluments for prosecutors and public attorneys, shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Act.
The funds necessary for the operation of the courts herein created shall be appropriated and released only upon the actual organization of the court and the appointment of its personnel.

In view of the proposed additional branch of the Regional Trial Court, the Regional Trial Courts in the Municipality of Maramag, Province of Bukidnon, shall have a staffing pattern as follows:
No. of Positions
Position Title
Salary Grade 1 Regional Trial Court Judge 29 1 Clerk of Court VI 25 1 Court Legal Researcher II 15 1 Interpreter III 12 4 Court Stenographer III 12 1 Sheriff IV 12 1 Data Entry Machine Operator II 8 2 Clerk III 6 1 Process Server 5 1 Utility Worker I 1 14 Personnel The staff complement of the new Office of the Clerk of Court (OCC) shall be composed on nine (9) personnel, while the data entry machine operator (DEMO) from the original Regional Trial Court will be transferred to the OCC, unless modified as determined by the Supreme Court.
In addition, there shall be appointed the corresponding number of prosecutor/s and public attorney/s and their support staff based on the ratio outlined in Republic Act No. 10071 and Republic Act No. 9406, respectively.

Section 14(k) of Batas Pambansa Blg. 129, otherwise known as "The Judiciary Reorganization Act of 1980", as amended, and all other laws, rules and regulations which are inconsistent with this Act are hereby amended, repealed or modified accordingly.
This Act shall take effect after fifteen (15) days after of its publication in the Official Gazette or in a newspaper of general circulation.
